scenicChapters.title: East Coast Highway 11
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is East Coast Highway 11, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

road-east-coast-highway-11-part-3.story: On the way it passes Dulan, Taitung, back through Dulan and back through Sanxiantai. The highest point is about 1,150 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

sections.advice: The Luxulyan Valley → Caradon Mining District is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Caradon Mining District → Devoran and Perran is 73 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Devoran and Perran → St Just Mining District is 52 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
St Just Mining District → back through Devoran and Perran is 52 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Devoran and Perran → back through Caradon Mining District is 73 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
back through Caradon Mining District → The Luxulyan Valley is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-the-luxulyan-valley-st-just-minin.story: 339 km from Par to Par, about 5 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Caradon Mining District, Devoran and Perran, St Just Mining District and back through Devoran and Perran. Rivers set the line for much of the day.
